from(bucket: "symphony")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "electrical.batteries.house.capacity.stateOfCharge")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["self"] == "true")
